user_stories.story: As a Compliance Officer, I want to browse a 'Global Library' of regulations, so that I can find laws relevant to my business.
acceptance_criteria: User can search a global database of regulations (Tier 2).
User can filter by Sector and Jurisdiction.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Officer, I want to 'Adopt' a regulation from the Global Library into my organization, so that I can track compliance against it.
acceptance_criteria: User can click 'Adopt' on a regulation.
Regulation is copied/linked to the Organization's active register.
Adoption triggers the deep analysis (Tier 3) process.

user_stories.story: As a System, I want to continuously crawl global sources (Tier 1), so that the regulation bank is always up-to-date.
acceptance_criteria: System classifies 'Is Regulation?' to filter noise.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to be notified when an adopted regulation changes, so that I can update my compliance controls.
acceptance_criteria: System detects updates to source text.
User receives a notification of the change.
